transcript: I rank the moral commonwealth first because it feels the most balanced and humane. People actually caring about each other and doing the right thing without needing heavy control. After that, I put the green sustainable one and the simple low-tech one since I like the idea of living more lightly and in tune with nature. I put the AI and religious ones at the bottom because they feel too controlling or rigid for me.
